platform_goal: An open, composable education operating system that gives every tenant a locally governed experience without forking the product.

operating_model.linux: Portable across x86_64 and ARM64, open standards, composable services, no device or vendor lock-in.
operating_model.aws: A small set of governed primitives, explicit deployment profiles, regional cells, measurable capacity, and operator-grade observability.
operating_model.salesforce: Tenant metadata, policy, vocabulary, permissions, workflow, and localization configure behavior without tenant code forks.
operating_model.shopify: Versioned capability packages, marketplace extensions, stable contracts, safe activation, and reversible rollout.
operating_model.local: Language, terminology, jurisdiction, calendar, grading, currency, workflow, residency, connectivity, and support posture are resolved per tenant.

canonical_owners.edge_inference: Ollama reached by the Django server through the AI gateway
canonical_owners.offline_mutations: existing offline queue, WAL, idempotency, and conflict-review contracts
canonical_owners.layout: existing shell, responsive CSS, table grammar, and row-detail drawers

optional_completion.browser_inference: Repository integration complete; disabled until an operator stages a same-origin checksum-pinned pack and pilot evidence.
optional_completion.local_voice: Repository integration complete; disabled until operator-approved LAN endpoints and language evidence exist.
optional_completion.audit_retention: Signed archive-before-purge, exact-row verification, approval token, and legal holds.
optional_completion.ai_task_routing: Per-task tiers, LiteLLM-compatible self-hosting, and tenant premium caps are implemented.
optional_completion.sensitive_alerts: High/critical audit events and tenant role changes emit governed alerts.
optional_completion.transaction_pooling: Unsupported and rejected fail-closed; direct or session pooling is required.

required_product_truths: Browser inference is optional and evidence-gated.
OCR proposes; an authorized human confirms final grades.
CRDT convergence does not guarantee preservation of every concurrent intent.
Hardware support is capability-based, not tied to a named board.
Cloud, LAN, guided, and browser tiers may share contracts but not identical quality.
Repository evidence cannot promote an intelligence feature into pilot or production.
